row.description: Real convention: IEC 60076 vector-group notation identifies winding connections and the phase-displacement clock number, such as Dyn11 or Yy0. Wrong generalization: assuming the clock number is always two characters because common examples end in 11 would reject valid one-digit clock numbers such as 0 or 5.

neighbors.distinction: Expresses impedance data rather than winding connection and phase displacement.
May resemble a compact mixed-case engineering identifier but does not use transformer clock-hour semantics.
